feature_name: Optimize Visitor Lifecycle for Memory Efficiency
description: Modify the visitor compilation lifecycle to reset state at the end of linting a file rather than at the beginning of the next file. This change allows visit functions to be garbage collected earlier, reducing memory pressure and improving performance by enabling garbage collection to occur between files while Rust-side code is processing.
functional_requirements: Remove the call to `initCompiledVisitor` at the start of the visitor compilation process.
Add a call to `resetCompiledVisitor` at the end of linting a file, after walking the AST with the compiled visitor.
Ensure the new lifecycle order is: 1) addVisitorToCompiled, 2) finalizeVisitor, 3) walk AST, 4) resetCompiledVisitor.
Update any tests to reflect the new lifecycle order and verify that state is correctly reset after each file.
